This role is ideal for a professional with 2-4 years of experience who brings a strong foundation in change management and excels at translating complex initiatives into clear, compelling, and visually impactful PowerPoint presentations. You will play a key role in driving alignment, clarity, and adoption by owning core deliverables across communications, stakeholder engagement, and training.
